//enabled: Add the Admin Trader to the game at backend start. Turning this off does not remove a trader already written into a running server's database -- restart the backend.
//nickname: What the trader is called on the trading screen. This is the one setting that applies live: change it on the in-game settings page and the trader is renamed on the spot.
//maxOffers: How many handbook items he stocks. The handbook holds about 4,300 tradeable items, so the default is effectively 'all of them'. Lower it if you want a shorter list to scroll.
